title: key.rs: EcCurve, KeyWrapAlgorithm, KariKeyAgreement lack Display impl
description: EcCurve, KeyWrapAlgorithm, and KariKeyAgreement are public enums in the API that are passed to DecryptionKey::agree_ecdh(). They have Debug but no Display. While they are algorithm descriptors rather than error types, the convention in this crate is that public enums implement Display (DigestAlgorithm, KeyEncryptionAlgorithm all do). Callers who want to log which algorithm was offered cannot format these without using Debug ({:?}) which includes the rust type name prefix. Add Display impl consistent with existing DigestAlgorithm.
